svg.text: Cloud agent scope: four nested walls
1. REPO: fixed when the task starts. One repo per run; other repos = context only (via MCP settings)
2. BRANCH: one branch, one PR per task. New copilot/ branch from the base branch you pick,
or the PR's own branch when you @copilot on a PR. Set by the execution context, not the agent profile
3. RULES: branch protections + required checks apply. An incompatible rule (e.g. allowed commit
authors) BLOCKS the agent. Ruleset fix: add Copilot as a bypass actor (not for branch protection)
4. REVIEW: only users with write access can trigger it. It opens a draft PR; a human must review
and merge. The requester can't approve it. Workflows wait for 'Approve and run workflows'.
Simple pushes only: no direct git push.
